title: ficus insipida subsp. segoviae
intro: Ficus insipida subsp. segoviae, commonly known as the Philippine banyan, is a plant species that belongs to the Moraceae family. It is traditionally used in various folk remedies and has been reported to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help in the management of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ficus insipida subsp. segoviae, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and antihistamine activities. Additionally, the plant has been used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, and may also exhibit antiparasitic and antiviral properties.
